title: BlackboardSignal.v1
description: A SIGNAL entry: an open question or prompt posted to the blackboard to direct the swarm's next attention (e.g. 'what is the sanction's effective date?'). Procedural, not truth-bearing — a signal asserts nothing about the world, so it carries no source_refs requirement of its own. priority orders the swarm's work queue. The matching BlackboardEntry row (kind=signal) carries the shared envelope incl. serves_truth=false.

entry_id.description: id of the BlackboardEntry (kind=signal) this body belongs to

blackboard_id.description: the blackboard this signal belongs to

question.description: the open question / prompt directing the swarm's attention

priority.description: ordering weight for the work queue (higher = sooner); numeric, not a display label
